title.en: To the Tune Jiangchengzi: Hunting at Mizhou

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource.

source.name: Wikisource
source.url: https://zh.wikisource.org/wiki/江城子_(蘇軾)/江城子_(密州出獵)

basis.en: Song dynasty lyric (ci); the author died in 1101.

note.en: Written in 1075, when Su Shi, not yet forty and prefect of Mizhou, went out hunting with his men; in a letter he described it as a lyric in a manner of his own, unlike the soft songs then in fashion, and it is often counted as the start of the bold style of ci. Sun Quan once shot a tiger from horseback, Feng Tang was an old official recalled to service, and the Wolf Star is Sirius. It is on this shelf for the second stanza: grey at the temples, and what of it.
note.zh: 1075 年苏轼任密州知州，年近四十，率众出猎时作；他在一封信里说这首词“自是一家”，与当时流行的柔婉之作不同，常被看作豪放词的开端。孙郎是曾亲自骑马射虎的孙权，冯唐是被重新起用的老臣，天狼是天狼星。放在这里，是为了下阕那一句：鬓微霜，又何妨。

excerpt.orig: 酒酣胸膽尚開張，鬢微霜，又何妨。
excerpt.en: Warm with wine, my heart and nerve are bold; / a little frost at my temples: what of it?
excerpt.zh: 酒酣胸胆尚开张，鬓微霜，又何妨。
